articles.title: MGM+ Greenlights the American Heiress Starring Emmy Winner Julianna Margulies, Based on the New York Times Best-Selling Novel by Daisy Goodwin
articles.description: Download Headshot HERE - - MGM+, the premium linear and streaming service, announced today that it has greenlit The American Heiress, an eight-episode romantic comedy of manners starring Julianna Margulies as Isabella Cash, based on best-selling author and showrunner Daisy Goodwin's novel with executive producer and FilmNation Entertainment's chief creative officer Stacey Snider.
